arxiv-1904-06399.title: PerfVis: Pervasive Visualization in Immersive Augmented Reality for Performance Awareness Conference: Tenth ACM/SPEC International Conference on Performance Engineering Companion; April 7–11, 2019; Mumbai, India Tenth ACM/SPEC International Conference on Performance Engineering Companion (ICPE ’19 C
arxiv-1904-06399.creator: Leonel Merino, Mario Hess, Alexandre Bergel, Oscar Nierstrasz, Daniel Weiskopf
arxiv-1904-06399.description: Abstract . Developers are usually unaware of the impact of code changes to the performance of software systems. Although developers can analyze the performance of a system by executing, for instance, a performance test to compare the performance of two consecutive versions of the system, changing from a programming task to a testing task would disrupt the development flow.

arxiv-2109-09134.title: Mean field control and finite agent approximation for regime-switching jump diffusions Thanks: E. Bayraktar is supported in part by the National Science Foundation under grant DMS-2106556 and in part by the Susan M. Smith Professorship.
arxiv-2109-09134.creator: Erhan Bayraktar, Alekos Cecchin, Prakash Chakraborty
arxiv-2109-09134.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Erhan Bayraktar, Alekos Cecchin, Prakash Chakraborty. We consider a jump-diffusion mean field control problem with regime switching in the state dynamics. The corresponding value function is characterized as the unique viscosity solution of a HJB master equation on the space of probability measures. Using this characterization, we prove that the value function, which is not regular, is the limit of a finite agent centralized optimal control problem as the number of agents go to infinity, with an explicit convergence rate.

arxiv-2309-05550.title: Multiplierless Design of High-Speed Very Large Constant Multiplications
arxiv-2309-05550.creator: Levent Aksoy 2 , Debapriya Basu Roy 3 , Malik Imran 2 , Samuel Pagliarini 2
arxiv-2309-05550.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Levent Aksoy 2 , Debapriya Basu Roy 3 , Malik Imran 2 , Samuel Pagliarini 2. In cryptographic algorithms, the constants to be multiplied by a variable can be very large due to security requirements. Thus, the hardware complexity of such algorithms heavily depends on the design architecture handling large constants.

arxiv-2405-17712.title: A Context-Aware Approach for Enhancing Data Imputation with Pre-trained Language Models
arxiv-2405-17712.creator: Ahatsham Hayat, Mohammad Rashedul Hasan
arxiv-2405-17712.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel approach named C ontextually R elevant I mputation leveraging pre-trained L anguage M odels ( CRILM ) for handling missing data in tabular datasets. Instead of relying on traditional numerical estimations, CRILM uses pre-trained language models (LMs) to create contextually relevant descriptors for missing values.

arxiv-2501-07723.title: ESURF: Simple and Effective EDU Segmentation
arxiv-2501-07723.creator: Mohammedreza Sediqin, Shlomo Engelson Argamon
arxiv-2501-07723.description: Abstract Segmenting text into Elemental Discourse Units (EDUs) is a fundamental task in discourse parsing. We present a new simple method for identifying EDU boundaries, and hence segmenting them, based on lexical and character n-gram features, using random forest classification.

arxiv-2504-07128.title: DeepSeek-R1 Thoughtology: Let’s think about LLM reasoning
arxiv-2504-07128.creator: Sara Vera Marjanović, Arkil Patel, Vaibhav Adlakha, Milad Aghajohari, Parishad BehnamGhader, Mehar Bhatia, Aditi Khandelwal, Austin Kraft, Benno Krojer, Xing Han Lù, Nicholas Meade, Dongchan Shin, Amirhossein Kazemnejad, Gaurav Kamath, Marius Mosbach, Karolina Stańczak, Siva Reddy
arxiv-2504-07128.description: Abstract Large Reasoning Models like DeepSeek-R1 mark a fundamental shift in how LLMs approach complex problems. Instead of directly producing an answer for a given input, DeepSeek-R1 creates detailed multi-step reasoning chains, seemingly “thinking” about a problem before providing an answer.

arxiv-2505-02113.title: Translational-Symmetry-Broken Magnetization Plateaux of the S = 3 / 2 S=3/2 Anisotropic Antiferromagnetic Chain

arxiv-2505-02113.description: Abstract The magnetization process of the S = 3 / 2 S=3/2 quantum spin chain with the X ​ X ​ Z XXZ anisotropy and the single-ion anisotropy D D is investigated using the numerical diagonalization of finite-size clusters and the level spectroscopy analysis.

arxiv-2512-09804.title: OnCoCo 1.0: A Public Dataset for Fine-Grained Message Classification in Online Counseling Conversations
arxiv-2512-09804.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . This paper presents OnCoCo 1.0, a new public dataset for fine-grained message classification in online counseling. It is based on a new, integrative system of categories, designed to improve the automated analysis of psychosocial online counseling conversations. Existing category systems, predominantly based on Motivational Interviewing (MI), are limited by their narrow focus and dependence on datasets derived mainly from face-to-face counseling. This limits the detailed examination of textual counseling conversations.

arxiv-2512-11742.title: On the physical running of the electric charge in a dimensionless theory of gravity
arxiv-2512-11742.creator: M. Gomes, A. C. Lehum, A. J. da Silva
arxiv-2512-11742.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by M. Gomes, A. C. Lehum, A. J. da Silva. We revisit the renormalization of the gauge coupling in massless QED coupled to a scaleless quadratic theory of gravity. We compare two alternative prescriptions for the running of the electric charge: (i) the conventional μ \mu -running in minimal subtraction, and (ii) a “physical” running extracted from the logarithmic dependence of amplitudes on a hard scale Q 2 Q^{2} (e.g., p 2 p^{2} or a Mandelstam invariant) after removing IR effects.

arxiv-2512-19441.creator: Benjamin Bonnefont, Hermanni Rajamäki, Vincent Vargas
arxiv-2512-19441.description: Abstract . We study the Fourier coefficients of imaginary Gaussian multiplicative chaos (GMC) on the unit circle. Under the subcritical phase β ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) \beta\in(0,1) , we show that the Fourier dimension is 1 − β 2 1-\beta^{2} and prove a central limit theorem for the rescaled coefficients. 1.

pmc-10767795.title: A rare case of extrarenal Wilms tumor of the uterine corpus: comprehensive genomic profile and review of the literature
pmc-10767795.creator: Lara Alessandrini, Angela Guerriero, Giada Munari, Biancamaria Del Forno, Luisa Santoro, Matteo Marchetti, Margherita Nardin, Roberto Tozzi, Matteo Fassan, Angelo Paolo Dei Tos
pmc-10767795.description: SummaryWilms tumor (WT), or nephroblastoma, is an uncommon malignant neoplasm occurring in the kidney of pediatric patients. Its extrarenal location is extremely rare and has been reported in various sites, including the female genital tract, with only 9 cases arising in the uterine corpus.

pmc-10984664.title: Smartphone sensor data estimate alcohol craving in a cohort of patients with alcohol-associated liver disease and alcohol use disorder
pmc-10984664.creator: Tiffany Wu, Garrick Sherman, Salvatore Giorgi, Priya Thanneeru, Lyle H. Ungar, Patrick S. Kamath, Douglas A. Simonetto, Brenda L. Curtis, Vijay H. Shah
pmc-10984664.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background:Sensors within smartphones, such as accelerometer and location, can describe longitudinal markers of behavior as represented through devices in a method called digital phenotyping. This study aimed to assess the feasibility of digital phenotyping for patients with alcohol-associated liver disease and alcohol use disorder, determine correlations between smartphone data and alcohol craving, and establish power assessment for future studies to prognosticate clinical outcomes.Methods:A total of 24 individuals with alcohol-associated liver disease and alcohol use disorder were instructed to download the AWARE application

pmc-11353090.title: Prior Advanced Care Planning and Outcomes of Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation in the Emergency Department of a Comprehensive Cancer Center
pmc-11353090.creator: Adriana H Wechsler, Marcelo Sandoval, Jayne Viets-Upchurch, Maria Cruz Carreras, Valda D Page, Ahmed Elsayem, Aiham Qdaisat, Sai-Ching J Yeung, Javier Marco-Hernández
pmc-11353090.description: Simple SummaryAs more cancer patients with advanced disease present to the emergency department (ED), data on outcomes of cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) are needed to help counsel patients before and during an acute event. We investigated the characteristics of cancer patients who required CPR, their outcomes, and how prior advanced care planning (ACP) influenced these outcomes.

pmc-11387059.title: Dynamic effects of thermal acclimation on chytridiomycosis infection intensity and transmission potential in Xenopus laevis
pmc-11387059.creator: James E Noelker, Vitoria Abreu Ruozzi, Kyle D Spengler, Hunter M Craig, Thomas R Raffel
pmc-11387059.description: The pandemic amphibian pathogen Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis (Bd) can cause more severe infections with variable temperatures owing to delays in host thermal acclimation following temperature shifts. However, little is known about the timing of these acclimation effects or their consequences for Bd transmission.

pmc-11489359.title: Ultra high-performance liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry: Development and validation of an analytical method for N2-Ethyl-2’-deoxyguanosine in dried blood spot
pmc-11489359.creator: Dimas Prayuda, Yahdiana Harahap, Bantari Wisynu Kusuma Wardhani
pmc-11489359.description: In the body, ethanol is metabolized to acetaldehyde by alcohol dehydrogenase and CYP2E1. Acetaldehyde is the main carcinogen that forms DNA adducts, N2-Ethylidene-2'-deoxyguanosine (N2-Ethylidene-dG), which can cause DNA damage and lead to cancer. However, N2-Ethylidene-dG is an unstable form at the nucleoside level and is difficult to measure. So it needs to be reduced using NaBH4 to become N2-Ethyl-2'-deoxyguanosine (N2-Et-dG).

The intestinal bacterial community can play crucial roles in animal development; however, little is known about the alteration of the gut microbial community of A.

pmc-11676979.title: Generation and Assessment of Soybean (Glycine max (L.) Merr.) Hybrids for High-Efficiency Agrobacterium-Mediated Transformation
pmc-11676979.creator: Muhammad Waqar Khan, Aaqib Shaheen, Xuebin Zhang, Junli Zhang, Yaser Hassan Dewir, Katalin Magyar-Tábori
pmc-11676979.description: The Agrobacterium-mediated technique is widely employed for soybean transformation, but the efficiency of this method is still relatively modest, in which multiple factors are involved. Numerous chemical and physiological cues from host plants are needed for A. tumefaciens attraction and subsequent T-DNA integration into the plant genome.

pmc-13054382.title: Pygopagus conjoined twins: A case report and neurosurgical nuances in separation surgery
pmc-13054382.creator: Rafael Harter Tomaszeski, Luiza Ribeiro, Lilian Carine Souza de Lima Abdon, Gerson Evandro Perondi, Samir Cezimbra Dos Santos
pmc-13054382.description: Background: Conjoined twins are univitelline, monochorionic, and monoamniotic, with imperfect division. The estimated worldwide prevalence is 1.47/100,000 births, with approximately 50% resulting in live births. They are classified according to the most prominent site of fusion. Pygopagus twins are joined at the sacral region and are the third most common variation, representing 6–19% of conjoined twins.

pmc-13092425.title: Percutaneous Cryoablation Under Local Anesthesia for Pulmonary Metastases From Colorectal Cancer: Long‐Term Outcomes From a Single‐Institution Retrospective Cohort
pmc-13092425.creator: Shun Yorimori, Kaoru Kaseda, Yusuke Aoki, Kosuke Sugino, Takahiro Suzuki, Yu Okubo, Shigeki Suzuki, Kyohei Masai, Masashi Tamura, Masanori Inoue, Hideki Yashiro, Seishi Nakatsuka, Yoshikane Yamauchi, Yotaro Izumi, Masafumi Kawamura, Masahiro Jinzaki, Keisuke Asakura
pmc-13092425.description: BackgroundSurgical resection is the standard treatment for pulmonary metastases from colorectal cancer, but its safety and long‐term efficacy in medically inoperable patients remain limited. Percutaneous cryoablation is a minimally invasive alternative to surgical resection and has gained increasing attention in recent years.

pmc-13154565.title: Exploring psychological distress, appraisal, and coping during the scan result journey: a qualitative study of young and middle-aged Chinese adults with advanced cancer
pmc-13154565.creator: Xingru Li, Youmin Lu, Yifan Fan, Wenguang xie, Chao Zhang
pmc-13154565.description: BackgroundScan-related distress is common in patients with advanced cancer. Young and middle-aged Chinese patients influenced by Confucian culture and identity stages may experience unique psychological distress following the scans.AimTo investigate the psychological distress and coping strategies in young and middle-aged Chinese patients with advanced cancer during the period from the scan result waiting phase to disclosure.

pmc-13594222.title: HOMEODOMAIN-LIKE shapes chromatin architecture and rewires leaf epidermal patterns
pmc-13594222.creator: Ansar Ali, Chi Kuan, Tsai-Chen Chen, Fu-Yu Hung, Pei-Yu Lin, Ding Hua Lee, Guan-Jun Lin, Hui-Chun Lee, Shao-Li Yang, Yun-Ru Feng, Chung-Ju Rachel Wang, Pao-Yang Chen, Keqiang Wu, Chin-Min Kimmy Ho
pmc-13594222.description: During development, cells balance proliferation and differentiation to generate diverse cell types, yet how these transitions are fine-tuned remains unclear. In the Arabidopsis leaf epidermis, stomata form through regulated cell division, whereas pavement cells and trichomes arise through differentiation, making this tissue a tractable system for identifying modulators of developmental decisions.

pmc-13617086.title: The serial mediating roles of protecting from risks and digital sharing in the relationship between self-control and the desire for being liked
pmc-13617086.creator: İdris Kara
pmc-13617086.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeThis study investigates the mediating role of digital protecting from risks and digital sharing in the influence of one of the Big Five personality traits, namely, self-control, on the desire for being liked. We examine the role of the desire for being liked in relation to the other Big Five personality traits and digital factors such as digital protecting from risks and digital sharing.
